visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a pink cut-out top and jeans, stands in a brightly lit office-like room. She holds a Nintendo Switch. Behind her, a large flat-screen TV displays a colorful video game featuring the character Kirby. (2) Close-up shots show the woman's hands using a black Nintendo Switch controller grip. Her fingers move the analog stick and press the 'B' button specifically. In-game footage shows Kirby racing on tracks with vibrant colors and various obstacles. (3) The scene shifts between the woman sitting at a white table playing while looking at the TV, and close-ups of her playing in handheld mode on a Switch OLED. The game's menu and various racing environments (forests, futuristic tracks) are shown with smooth editing cuts. (4) The woman stands back up in front of the TV, which now shows a victory or end-game screen. She gestures energetically with her hands, pointing at the screen and looking directly at the camera with a smile. The background includes office furniture like black chairs and a whiteboard.
